title: A nowhere-dense closed subscheme of a one-dimensional scheme has dimension zero
statement: Let $k$ be a field, let $X$ be a scheme of finite type over $k$ [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] with $\dim X\le 1$ [def-pc-dimension], and let $Z\subseteq X$ be a closed subscheme (given by a closed immersion $Z\to X$ [def-weil-closed-immersion]) whose underlying set is nowhere dense in $X$. Then $\dim Z\le0$ (with $\dim\varnothing=-\infty$), and every point of $Z$ is closed in $Z$.
